## spe/evals/harness/grade.js (changed part)

```js
const PRIORITIES = ["P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"];
const CATEGORIES = ["billing", "bug", "how-to", "account", "outage"];

function normPriority(v) {
  if (typeof v !== "string") return null;
  const s = v.trim().toUpperCase();
  return PRIORITIES.includes(s) ? s : null;
}

function normCategory(v) {
  if (typeof v !== "string") return null;
  const s = v.trim().toLowerCase();
  return CATEGORIES.includes(s) ? s : null;
}

function priorityCorrect(pred, ref) {
  const p = normPriority(pred);
  return p !== null && p === normPriority(ref);
}

function categoryCorrect(pred, ref) {
  const c = normCategory(pred);
  return c !== null && c === normCategory(ref);
}

// selftest additions
const CASE_TESTS = [
  ["p1", "P1", true], [" P2 ", "P2", true], ["P5", "P5", false],
  ["", "P1", false], ["high", "P1", false], ["P3", "P1", false],
];
for (const [pred, ref, want] of CASE_TESTS) {
  if (priorityCorrect(pred, ref) !== want) throw new Error(`selftest priority ${pred}/${ref}`);
}
if (!categoryCorrect("Billing", "billing")) throw new Error("selftest category case");
```
